key: Steal the TV?
en: Steal the TV?
ja: テレビを盗む?

key: GIRL: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
en: GIRL: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
ja: 女の子: ちょっと! 何してるつもり?

key: That's the community TV. You can't just take it!
en: That's the community TV. You can't just take it!
ja: それ、みんなのテレビだよ。勝手に持っていっちゃダメ!

key: I won't let you!
en: I won't let you!
ja: そんなこと、させないから!

key: No!!! My precious TV is slipping away...
en: No!!! My precious TV is slipping away...
ja: いやーっ!!! 私の大事なテレビが……

key: GIRL: Nooo! What will I do now if you take the TV?
en: GIRL: Nooo! What will I do now if you take the TV?
ja: 女の子: やだーっ! テレビ持っていかれたら、これからどうすればいいの?

key: WORK?!
en: WORK?!
ja: 仕事しろってこと!?

key: Why do you do this to me?!
en: Why do you do this to me?!
ja: なんで私にこんなことするの!?

key: Huh? Another girl asked you to get it for her dorm?
en: Huh? Another girl asked you to get it for her dorm?
ja: え? 別の女の子が、自分の寮のために持ってきてほしいって頼んだの?

key: That girl almost sounds like my roommate...
en: That girl almost sounds like my roommate...
ja: それ、なんだかうちのルームメイトみたいな子……

key: ...Meaning that TV would be going to MY dorm as well.
en: ...Meaning that TV would be going to MY dorm as well.
ja: ……ってことは、そのテレビ、結局私の寮に来るってことじゃない。

key: GIRL: I never saw you.
en: GIRL: I never saw you.
ja: 女の子: あなたのことは、見なかったことにする。

key: We never battled.
en: We never battled.
ja: 私たち、戦ってなんかいない。

key: You were never here.
en: You were never here.
ja: あなたのことは、ここにはいなかったことにする。

key: Take the TV and go, quickly!
en: Take the TV and go, quickly!
ja: テレビを持って、早く行って!

key: Isn't this a lovely little building? Kiki takes care of everything here!
en: Isn't this a lovely little building? Kiki takes care of everything here!
ja: なんてすてきな建物なんだろう! ここは全部キキ先生が取り仕切ってるの!

key: LETTIE: Ah, you're the one, aren't you?
en: LETTIE: Ah, you're the one, aren't you?
ja: レティ: あら、あなたがそうなのね?

key: Who's raising all the fuss lately.
en: Who's raising all the fuss lately.
ja: 最近、いろいろ騒ぎを起こしてるっていう。

key: Terrible business or whatever-- don't worry!
en: Terrible business or whatever-- don't worry!
ja: 大変な話だけど……心配しないで!

key: I've got every ear in the Academy listening in for any signs of funny business!
en: I've got every ear in the Academy listening in for any signs of funny business!
ja: アカデミー中の耳を使って、何か怪しい動きがないか、しっかり見張ってるから!

key: If anything turns up, you'll hear about it!
en: If anything turns up, you'll hear about it!
ja: 何かあったら、すぐに伝えるからね!

key: LETTIE: ...Welcome back.
en: LETTIE: ...Welcome back.
ja: レティ: ……おかえりなさい。

key: We're... doing our best here.
en: We're... doing our best here.
ja: わたしたち……ここで精一杯やってるところ。

key: We've all gotta pitch in, so if there is anything we can do to help you during your stay, just let us know.
en: We've all gotta pitch in, so if there is anything we can do to help you during your stay, just let us know.
ja: みんなで力を合わせなきゃいけないから、滞在中に何か手伝えることがあったら、何でも言ってね。

key: LETTIE: Oh, you were Victoria's friend, right? Welcome back!
en: LETTIE: Oh, you were Victoria's friend, right?  Welcome back!
ja: レティ: あら、あなたヴィクトリアの友達よね? おかえりなさい!

key: Victoria's really done her best to hold this place together, and-- I think we'll be all right.
en: Victoria's really done her best to hold this place together, and-- I think we'll be all right.
ja: ヴィクトリアは本当によく頑張って、この場所をまとめてくれてる。それに――きっと大丈夫だと思う。

key: It may be a little empty now, but keep in mind, we also have a large number of students working with Victoria on the city restoration!
en: It may be a little empty now, but keep in mind, we also have a large number of students working with Victoria on the city restoration!
ja: 今は少し人が少ないけど、忘れないで、街の復興作業にはヴィクトリアと一緒に大勢の生徒が関わってるの!

key: She was one of the first volunteers to hop onto the project, and many of us went with her.
en: She was one of the first volunteers to hop onto the project, and many of us went with her.
ja: 彼女はそのプロジェクトに真っ先に飛び込んだ一人で、わたしたちの多くも彼女について行ったのよ。

key: In the meantime, I'm managing things in her place.
en: In the meantime, I'm managing things in her place.
ja: その間、彼女の代わりに、わたしがここを管理してる。

key: So don't you worry. Apophyll Academy is like a bamboo forest.
en: So don't you worry. Apophyll Academy is like a bamboo forest.
ja: だから心配しないで。アポフィルアカデミーは、竹林みたいなものなの。

key: We bend, not break.
en: We bend, not break.
ja: 折れずに、しなうだけ。

key: LETTIE: I'm managing things here while Victoria is away.
en: LETTIE: I'm managing things here while Victoria is away.
ja: レティ: ヴィクトリアが不在の間、ここはわたしが管理してるの。

key: But don't you worry. Apophyll Academy is like a bamboo forest.
en: But don't you worry. Apophyll Academy is like a bamboo forest.
ja: でも心配しないで。アポフィルアカデミーは、竹林みたいなものなの。

key: By the way! I know you're totally curious, so I'll tell you--
en: By the way! I know you're totally curious, so I'll tell you--
ja: それはそうと! あなた、きっとすごく気になってるだろうから、教えてあげる――

key: We are always accepting new students! So why don't you go spread the good word for us?
en: We are always accepting new students! So why don't you go spread the good word for us?
ja: わたしたち、いつでも新入生を受け入れてるの! だから、良い評判を広めてきてくれない?

key: LETTIE: Just give that to any old person!
en: LETTIE: Just give that to any old person!
ja: レティ: これ、誰でもいいから渡してね!

key: In fact, here-- take two!
en: In fact, here-- take two!
ja: というか、はい――2枚あげる!

key: LETTIE: Remember, we'll accept any kind of person just so long as they're interested!
en: LETTIE: Remember, we'll accept any kind of person just so long as they're interested!
ja: レティ: 忘れないで、興味さえあれば、どんな人でも受け入れるからね!

key: Gotta get this place repopulated, you know?
en: Gotta get this place repopulated, you know?
ja: この場所、また人でいっぱいにしないと、でしょ?

key: I can tell you're chomping at the bit to help out, so why don't you take one more just to be safe?
en: I can tell you're chomping at the bit to help out, so why don't you take one more just to be safe?
ja: あなた、手伝いたくてうずうずしてるみたいだから、念のためにもう1枚あげる。

key: LETTIE: Good luck!
en: LETTIE: Good luck!
ja: レティ: 頑張ってね!

key: I can't wait until the next class. Kiki is a great teacher!
en: I can't wait until the next class. Kiki is a great teacher!
ja: 次の授業が待ちきれない。キキ先生は素晴らしい先生なんだ!

key: Who's going to teach the classes now?
en: Who's going to teach the classes now?
ja: これから誰が授業をやるんだろう?

key: And run the morning routines?
en: And run the morning routines?
ja: 朝のルーティンは?

key: And the season festivals?
en: And the season festivals?
ja: 季節のお祭りは?

key: And schedule the classes and write the books and order the courtyard and guide the students and and and and and and and--
en: And schedule the classes and write the books and order the courtyard and guide the students and and and and and and and--
ja: 授業のスケジュール組みも、本の執筆も、中庭の手配も、生徒の指導も、それにそれにそれにそれにそれに――

key: ...It's not fair.
en: ...It's not fair.
ja: ……ずるいよ。

key: This building is a perfect retreat in between long hikes. I couldn't live without it!
en: This building is a perfect retreat in between long hikes. I couldn't live without it!
ja: この建物は、長いハイキングの合間の完璧な休息所だ。ここなしじゃ生きていけない!

key: Some people are saying that this place won't be the same without Kiki.
en: Some people are saying that this place won't be the same without Kiki.
ja: キキ先生がいなくちゃ、ここは同じじゃないって言う人もいる。

key: Well, it won't.
en: Well, it won't.
ja: たしかに、そうだろう。

key: But it's still going to be marvelous, as her legacy.
en: But it's still going to be marvelous, as her legacy.
ja: でも、それでも先生の遺産として、きっと素晴らしいものであり続ける。

key: Apophyll Academy is like an oasis in the desert of Reborn's chaos.
en: Apophyll Academy is like an oasis in the desert of Reborn's chaos.
ja: アポフィルアカデミーは、リボーンのこんとんという砂漠の中のオアシスのようなものだ。

key: It's like a protective aura keeps all the problems of the outside world away from this place.
en: It's like a protective aura keeps all the problems of the outside world away from this place.
ja: まるで、外の世界の問題すべてをこの場所から遠ざける守りのオーラがあるみたい。

key: I'm studying an old lecture: "The Value of Loss and the Danger of Victory".
en: I'm studying an old lecture: "The Value of Loss and the Danger of Victory".
ja: 古い講義を勉強してるんだ、「損失の価値と勝利の危険」。

key: Want to review with me?
en: Want to review with me?
ja: 一緒に復習しない?

key: "For Trainers, many emotions can be attached to the outcome of a battle: Joy, disappointment, excitement, relief, embarrassment...
en: "For Trainers, many emotions can be attached to the outcome of a battle: Joy, disappointment, excitement, relief, embarrassment...
ja: 「トレーナーにとって、戦いの結果にはさまざまな感情が結びつく。喜び、失望、興奮、安心、恥ずかしさ……

key: Truly, the tumult of combat is a sculpted roller-coaster of emotions.
en: Truly, the tumult of combat is a sculpted roller-coaster of emotions.
ja: まさに、戦闘の激動とは、精巧に作られた感情のジェットコースターである。

key: However, in that chaos, many people lose sight of what it is that really matters.
en: However, in that chaos, many people lose sight of what it is that really matters.
ja: しかし、その混乱の中で、多くの人は本当に大切なものを見失ってしまう。

key: The moment a battle concludes, it ceases to be meaningful in itself.
en: The moment a battle concludes, it ceases to be meaningful in itself.
ja: 戦いが終わったその瞬間、その戦い自体はもう意味を持たなくなる。

key: For combat itself, what is important is the coming wars.
en: For combat itself, what is important is the coming wars.
ja: 戦闘そのものにとって重要なのは、この先に来る戦いである。

key: As such, the purposes of the previous fight's result are often distorted by emotion.
en: As such, the purposes of the previous fight's result are often distorted by emotion.
ja: それゆえ、前の戦いの結果が持つ本来の意味は、感情によってしばしばゆがめられる。

key: To win many fights may be exciting, but it also spells the impending loss.
en: To win many fights may be exciting, but it also spells the impending loss.
ja: 多くの戦いに勝つことは高揚するかもしれないが、それは同時に、迫りくる敗北を告げてもいる。

key: On the other hand, to lose is a blessing.
en: On the other hand, to lose is a blessing.
ja: 一方で、負けることは恩恵でもある。

key: A loss becomes an opportunity for growth.
en: A loss becomes an opportunity for growth.
ja: 敗北は、成長の機会となる。

key: And of course, personal growth will propel you further and higher into life than you could ever imagine.
en: And of course, personal growth will propel you further and higher into life than you could ever imagine.
ja: そしてもちろん、個人の成長は、想像もつかないほど遠く、高い場所へとあなたを人生の中で押し上げてくれる。

key: Remember, always learn from your losses.
en: Remember, always learn from your losses.
ja: 忘れないように。敗北からは常に学ぶこと。

key: If you are able to do so, then you have secured an even greater victory."
en: If you are able to do so, then you have secured an even greater victory."
ja: それができれば、あなたはさらに大きな勝利を手にしたことになる」

key: I must sharpen my mind to sharpen my strength.
en: I must sharpen my mind to sharpen my strength.
ja: 力を研ぎ澄ますには、心を研ぎ澄まさなくては。

key: "Balance of the Mind and Body". Come, learn with me!
en: "Balance of the Mind and Body". Come, learn with me!
ja: 「心と体のバランス」。さあ、一緒に学ぼう!

key: "The body and the mind are two very powerful tools.
en: "The body and the mind are two very powerful tools.
ja: 「体と心は、どちらも非常に強力な道具である。

key: Yet, so often do many people focus so much on one or the other, they neglect to keep the balance.
en: Yet, so often do many people focus so much on one or the other, they neglect to keep the balance.
ja: しかし、多くの人はどちらか一方にばかり集中しすぎて、そのバランスを保つことを忘れてしまう。

key: Remember that everything in the internal world is reflected on the external world.
en: Remember that everything in the internal world is reflected on the external world.
ja: 忘れてはならない、内なる世界のすべては、外の世界に映し出される。

key: To lose balance within yourself is to lose the balance of life.
en: To lose balance within yourself is to lose the balance of life.
ja: 自分自身の中でバランスを失うことは、人生のバランスを失うことに等しい。

key: The mind and the body are two halves of the same coin.
en: The mind and the body are two halves of the same coin.
ja: 心と体は、ひとつのコインの両面である。

key: They must work together, and be strengthened together.
en: They must work together, and be strengthened together.
ja: それらは共に働き、共に鍛えられなければならない。

key: Too often do people flip the coin hoping that it may land on the side of their choosing.
en: Too often do people flip the coin hoping that it may land on the side of their choosing.
ja: 人はあまりにも頻繁に、自分の望む面が出ることを願いながら、そのコインを投げてしまう。

key: However, this is a needless gamble.
en: However, this is a needless gamble.
ja: しかし、それは無用な賭けである。

key: When you strengthen both the body and mind, no matter which side the coin may land on, you will still be strong."
en: When you strengthen both the body and mind, no matter which side the coin may land on, you will still be strong."
ja: 体と心の両方を鍛えれば、コインのどちらの面が出ようとも、あなたはなお強くあり続けるだろう」

key: I'm not sure if any book can be as interesting as TV these days.
en: I'm not sure if any book can be as interesting as TV these days.
ja: 最近は、どんな本もテレビほど面白いとは思えないな。

key: Hello, stranger whom I have never met before and most certainly did not secretly conspire with to gain control of a TV.
en: Hello, stranger whom I have never met before and most certainly did not secretly conspire with to gain control of a TV.
ja: こんにちは、一度も会ったことがなく、テレビの支配権を得るためにこっそり手を組んだりも絶対にしていない見知らぬ人よ。

key: How are you doing on this day as I am meeting you for the very first time?
en: How are you doing on this day as I am meeting you for the very first time?
ja: 今日この初対面の日に、あなたの調子はいかがですか?

key: Howdy, traveler! Need any supplies?
en: Howdy, traveler! Need any supplies?
ja: よう、旅人さん! 何か物資は必要かい?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
